faq.title: Frequently asked questions about gemstones
faq.subtitle: Get your technical questions answered before placing an order.

items.question: What does carat mean for a gemstone?
items.answer: Carat (ct) is a unit of mass, not size — one carat equals 200 milligrams. It's often confused with gold "karat" (which measures purity, in parts of 24), but for gemstones, carat is always weight. Two stones of the same carat weight can look different in size depending on the mineral's density and how they were cut — that's why carat weight alone never sets a piece's value; it's always weighed alongside cut, color, and clarity.

items.question: What's the difference between cut and cutting (lapidary work)?
items.answer: Lapidary work is the full process of turning a rough stone into the finished piece — shaping, polishing, and defining its final form. Cut is the outcome of that process: the geometric shape and facet arrangement (round, oval, emerald, pear, cushion, among others), plus the proportions and symmetry between those facets. A well-executed cut directly affects how a stone reflects and refracts light — two stones of the same mineral and the same weight can look strikingly different in brilliance depending on the quality of the cut.

items.question: What does a stone's clarity (or purity) mean?
items.answer: Clarity describes the presence of inclusions — small internal or external imperfections that occur naturally during a stone's geological formation — and how visible they are to the naked eye or under magnification. Gemological scales (such as FL/IF for stones with no visible inclusions, VVS, VS, SI, and I, in decreasing order of purity) classify this aspect. Higher-clarity stones tend to be rarer and more valuable, but for several species, inclusions are simply part of the stone's natural character and don't affect its beauty or durability.

items.question: How do I recognize a trustworthy gemological certificate?
items.answer: A trustworthy gemological report is issued by a laboratory or institute recognized in the field (in Brazil, IBGM — the Brazilian Institute of Gems and Precious Metals — is a reference), and should include, at minimum: mineral species identification, carat weight, dimensions, cut description, clarity and color notes, and any treatment identified in the stone. For higher-value pieces, it's always worth requesting the report before purchase — it's the independent confirmation that the stated characteristics match the physical stone.

items.question: What's the difference between a natural, synthetic, and treated stone?
items.answer: A natural stone forms through geological processes over thousands to millions of years. A synthetic (or "lab-grown") stone has the same chemical composition and crystal structure as its natural counterpart, but is produced artificially over a much shorter time — it shouldn't be confused with simulants (like cubic zirconia), which only imitate the appearance but have a different composition. A treated stone, meanwhile, is a natural stone that went through a process to enhance color or clarity (heating and oiling are the most common, for example in emeralds). Treatments are a common, accepted market practice as long as they're disclosed — which is why gemological reports typically note when a treatment has been identified.

items.question: How should I care for and clean jewelry with gemstones?
items.answer: Care varies by mineral species: more porous or oil-treated stones, like some emeralds, shouldn't go in ultrasonic cleaners or come into contact with harsh chemicals, which can strip the treatment and darken internal fissures. As a general, safe rule for most pieces: clean with lukewarm water, mild soap, and a soft-bristle brush, dry with a soft cloth, avoid sudden temperature changes, and store each piece separately to prevent scratching other jewelry. If you're unsure about a specific stone, it's always safest to ask before using any cleaning method.

items.question: Why do stones of the same "nominal color" vary in tone?
items.answer: A gemstone's color comes from trace chemical elements present during its geological formation — for example, chromium and vanadium give emeralds their characteristic green, while variations in the proportion of these elements (and the presence of iron) shift the tone between a more bluish or more yellowish green. Because the concentration of these elements varies from deposit to deposit — and even within the same deposit — two stones of the same mineral species and the same nominal color grade can show visibly different tones. That's also why geographic origin is often noted on the gemological report for higher-value pieces.

about.title: Curation and provenance in every gemstone
about.paragraph1: Cinzel e a Gema curates and sells fine gemstones, pairing quality with provenance in every piece we select. Since each stone is typically a one-of-a-kind item, we treat our catalog with the same care given to a collection — not a standardized inventory.
about.paragraph2: Our goal is to be a trusted reference for collectors and jewelry lovers, pairing transparency about each stone's origin and characteristics with close, attentive service.

qualityPolicyModal.title: Quality Policy
qualityPolicyModal.paragraph1: Cinzel e a Gema is committed to representing every gemstone accurately — weight, cut, origin, clarity, and other technical characteristics are described based on the information available for each piece, in the interest of earning the trust of all our customers and partners.
qualityPolicyModal.paragraph2: Because a stone's color is sensitive to lighting distortion, photos of every piece are taken under neutral light, aiming to represent the stone's true tone as faithfully as possible — without digital color correction.
qualityPolicyModal.paragraph3: We pursue continuous improvement in our curation — reviewing our processes, listening to customer feedback, and following gemological industry standards — as part of our ongoing commitment to quality and transparency.

privacy.metaTitle: Privacy Policy — Cinzel e a Gema
privacy.intro: This page explains what data the Cinzel e a Gema website collects, why, and how you can control that collection, in line with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD).
privacy.controllerBody: The controller of the data processed on this site is {{legalName}}, CNPJ (Brazilian company registry) {{cnpj}}, based at {{address}}. Privacy questions can be sent to {{email}}.
privacy.whatWeCollectBody: Site measurement (Google Analytics): pages viewed, traffic origin, terms typed into the catalog search, clicks on elements such as the WhatsApp and email buttons, add-to-order, and the shipping quote. In this measurement we never send Google your full postal code, payment data, name, phone number, or email. From the shipping quote, Google only receives city and state.
privacy.orderDataTitle: Data you provide when placing an order
privacy.orderDataBody: When you place an order, we ask for your name and phone number. We use this data only to talk to you about the order: confirming the pieces, payment, and delivery. It is sent to the store's customer service system (FluxioDesk). If that delivery isn't possible, the site opens a WhatsApp conversation with the message already written, which is only sent if you click send. The site does not store your name and phone number in its own database. We process this data to fulfill the order and attend to your request (LGPD, art. 7, V).
privacy.shippingCalcBody: To calculate shipping, the postal code you type is sent to our server, which queries ViaCEP (to identify the city and state) and Melhor Envio (to calculate price and delivery time). These services receive the postal code and the order's shipment data, but not your name or phone number. The postal code is saved only in your browser, so you don't lose the quote if the page reloads.
privacy.consentBody: When you arrive on the site, you see a banner asking whether you accept or reject this measurement. While you haven't answered, or if you choose "Reject", we use Google Consent Mode: no analytics cookie is set and no individual measurement happens. Google Analytics still receives aggregated, cookie-less signals to estimate overall traffic volume through statistical modeling — without being able to tell who you are or follow your browsing across visits. On a site with Cinzel e a Gema's traffic volume, this modeling is noticeably less precise than cookie-based measurement: it may fail to capture small traffic spikes correctly.
privacy.revokeBody: You can change your mind at any time by clicking "Cookie preferences" in the site footer, which reopens the banner and lets you accept or reject again.
privacy.cookiesTitle: Cookies and local storage used on this site
privacy.cookiesListConsent: cinzeleagema_consent — stores your consent choice (accept/reject) and the date of that choice.
privacy.cookiesListLocale: cinzeleagema_locale — stores your chosen language (Portuguese or English).
privacy.cookiesListCart: cinzeleagema_cart and cinzeleagema_shipping — store your in-progress order and shipping data, so you don't lose your progress if the page reloads.
privacy.cookiesListUtm: cinzeleagema_utm — stores, only for the current browser session (cleared when you close the tab), which promotional link/campaign you arrived from, so we can measure our promotion correctly.
privacy.cookiesListGa: Google Analytics' own cookies (such as _ga) — only set if you accept measurement in the banner.
privacy.sharingListGoogle: Google (Google Analytics), only with your consent.
privacy.sharingListHosting: Vercel and Railway, hosting for the site and the server — they receive the IP address of whoever accesses it.
privacy.sharingListPhotos: Cloudflare, hosting for the product photos.
privacy.sharingListShipping: ViaCEP and Melhor Envio, to calculate shipping.
privacy.sharingListSupport: The store's customer service system (FluxioDesk), for orders.
privacy.sharingListWhatsapp: WhatsApp/Meta, when you start a conversation.
privacy.sharingClosing: We do not sell your data.
privacy.internationalTransferBody: Some of these services, such as Google, Vercel, Railway, and Cloudflare, may process data on servers outside Brazil. When that happens, we follow LGPD's rules for international data transfer.
privacy.retentionTitle: How long we keep your data
privacy.retentionBody: Google Analytics measurement: 14 months. Data stored in your browser (cart, shipping, language): until you clear your browser data. Cookie choice: until you change it. Name and phone number from an order: for as long as needed to fulfill the order and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request, at any time, by emailing {{email}}: confirmation that we process your data; access; correction of incorrect data; anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary data; portability; information about who we share your data with; and withdrawal of consent (which can also be done directly through the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer). We respond within 15 days. You can also file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD), at gov.br/anpd.
privacy.contactBody: For any question about this policy, write to {{email}}.

exchangePolicy.metaTitle: Return and Exchange Policy — Cinzel e a Gema
exchangePolicy.divergenceNotice: In case of any divergence, the Portuguese version prevails.
exchangePolicy.withdrawalTitle: 1. Right of withdrawal (purchases made on the site)
exchangePolicy.withdrawalIntro: You may cancel your purchase within {{withdrawalDays}} calendar days from the date you received the piece, with no need to explain why (art. 49 of Brazil's Consumer Protection Code).
exchangePolicy.withdrawalListRequest: To request it, write to {{email}} or message us on WhatsApp with your order number. We reply within {{responseBusinessDays}} business days with shipping instructions.
exchangePolicy.withdrawalListCondition: The piece must come back in the same condition it was received: no improper use, no alterations (such as cutting, drilling, or setting), in its original packaging, and with any documents that came with it, if any.
exchangePolicy.withdrawalListShippingCost: Return shipping for withdrawal is paid by the store. We will send a shipping label or reimburse the cost upon proof of payment.
exchangePolicy.withdrawalListRefund: After receiving and checking the piece, we refund the amount paid, including the purchase's shipping cost, within {{refundBusinessDays}} business days, through the same payment method (Pix: to the same key; card: a refund that may appear on up to two statements, depending on the bank).
exchangePolicy.defectTitle: 2. Defective piece or different from what was advertised
exchangePolicy.defectIntro: If the piece arrives damaged, defective, or different from what was advertised (stone type, shape, or measurements outside the stated margin), let us know within {{defectNoticeDays}} days of delivery. We recommend reporting it in the first few days, with photos of the piece and the packaging.
exchangePolicy.defectListAnalysis: We review the case within {{defectAnalysisBusinessDays}} business days and, if confirmed, you choose between an exchange for an equivalent piece, a refund, or a proportional price reduction, as set out in art. 18 of the Consumer Protection Code.
exchangePolicy.defectListShippingCost: In these cases, shipping both ways is on us.
exchangePolicy.defectListDamagedTransport: If the piece is damaged in transit, keep the packaging and photograph it before discarding it.
exchangePolicy.naturalVariationTitle: 3. What does not count as a defect
exchangePolicy.naturalVariationBody: Natural stones vary in color, transparency, inclusions, veining, and finish. Small differences between the photo and the piece (tone variation from lighting and screen, approximate measurements) are part of the material and are described in each listing. Each piece is photographed individually; check the photo and measurements before buying.
exchangePolicy.voluntaryExchangeBody: After the withdrawal period, we accept an exchange for another piece on the site within {{voluntaryExchangeDays}} days, with the piece in its original condition, shipping paid by the customer, and any price difference adjusted. This option is a courtesy from the store and depends on availability.
exchangePolicy.customOrdersBody: Pieces made or adjusted to the customer's specifications have a specific notice in the listing and do not follow the standard withdrawal period, except in case of a defect.
exchangePolicy.howToRequestStep1: Contact us at {{email}} or on WhatsApp, with your order number and, if it's a defect, photos.
exchangePolicy.howToRequestStep2: Wait for our shipping instructions. Do not send the piece before that.
exchangePolicy.howToRequestStep3: Send the piece well packaged. Track the shipment using the tracking code.
exchangePolicy.howToRequestStep4: We'll let you know as soon as we receive and check it, and proceed with the exchange or refund.

saleTerms.metaTitle: Terms of Sale — Cinzel e a Gema
saleTerms.divergenceNotice: In case of any divergence, the Portuguese version prevails.
saleTerms.whoWeAreBody: The website www.cinzeleagema.com.br is operated by {{legalName}}, CNPJ {{cnpj}}, based at {{address}}. Customer service: {{email}} and WhatsApp {{whatsapp}}, {{serviceHours}}.
saleTerms.productsBody: We sell natural precious and semi-precious stones, shapes, decorative pieces, and accessories. Each listing includes photos of the actual piece, material type, and approximate measurements and weight. Since these are natural materials, each piece is unique: color, transparency, inclusions, and finish may vary slightly from the photos, which also depend on screen and lighting. Our pieces do not come with an authenticity certificate or report.
saleTerms.pricingListPrices: Prices are in Brazilian reais (R$) and apply at the time the order is placed.
saleTerms.pricingListAvailability: Since most pieces are one of a kind, availability is limited to a single unit. If a piece is sold through another channel before payment is confirmed, we will let you know and refund the full amount within {{refundBusinessDays}} business days.
saleTerms.pricingListPayment: Payment methods: Pix and credit card, {{installments}}. The order is confirmed once payment is approved.
saleTerms.shippingListCalculation: Shipping is calculated in the cart, by postal code, with options from Correios (Brazil's postal service) and, when available, a carrier. We do not currently offer free shipping.
saleTerms.shippingListPosting: We ship within {{shippingBusinessDays}} business days after payment is confirmed, via the carrier or Correios, depending on the option you choose in the cart. The delivery time shown in the quote starts counting after the item ships.
saleTerms.shippingListPackaging: We ship with protective packaging. Check the package on arrival and, if it's been tampered with or damaged, refuse the delivery or let us know the same day.
saleTerms.exchangeAfterLink: apply. To cancel an order before it ships, contact us as soon as possible; we will refund the full amount.
